_note: A throwaway corpus for the worked example. The skill 'widget-painter' is for PAINTING widgets — colors, themes, fills. Positives are paint requests across phrasings. Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from its sibling 'widget-modeler' (which owns the widget's DATA MODEL — schema, fields, validation) — the territory widget-painter must REPEL, not grab.
positives: recolor the widget to match the theme
set the widget fill and stroke colors
apply a color theme to the widget
negatives: design the widget schema and fields
add validation to the widget model
